items.source: Convert the given source to the specified targetType.
items.translation: 将给定的source转换为指定的targetType。

items.source: ConversionException - if a conversion exception occurred
items.translation: ConversionException - 如果发生转换异常

items.source: Special note on collections, arrays, and maps types: For conversion between collection, array, and map types, this method will return true even though a convert invocation may still generate a ConversionException if the underlying elements are not convertible. Callers are expected to handle this exceptional case when working with collections and maps.
items.translation: 关于集合、数组和映射类型的特别注意事项： 对于集合、数组和映射类型之间的转换，即使底层元素不可转换，此方法仍可能返回 true，但转换调用仍可能生成一个 ConversionException。调用者在使用集合和映射时，应处理这种异常情况。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if targetType is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 targetType 为 null

items.source: targetType - the target type to convert to (required)
items.translation: targetType - 要转换的目标类型（必需）

items.source: If this method returns true, it means convert(Object, Class) is capable of converting an instance of sourceType to targetType.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回 `true`，则意味着convert(Object, Class)能够将sourceType的实例转换为targetType。

items.source: If this method returns true, it means convert(Object, TypeDescriptor, TypeDescriptor) is capable of converting an instance of sourceType to targetType.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回 `true`，则意味着convert(Object, TypeDescriptor, TypeDescriptor)能够将sourceType的实例转换为targetType。

items.source: Delegates to convert(Object, TypeDescriptor, TypeDescriptor) and encapsulates the construction of the source type descriptor using TypeDescriptor.forObject(Object).
items.translation: 委托给 convert(Object, TypeDescriptor, TypeDescriptor)，并使用 TypeDescriptor.forObject(Object) 封装源类型描述符的构建。

items.source: Return true if objects of sourceType can be converted to the targetType.
items.translation: 如果可以将sourceType的对象转换为targetType，则返回true。

items.source: A service interface for type conversion. This is the entry point into the convert system. Call convert(Object, Class) to perform a thread-safe type conversion using this system.
items.translation: 用于类型转换的服务接口。这是转换系统的入口点。调用convert(Object, Class) 使用此系统执行线程安全的类型转换。

items.source: Convert the given source to the specified targetType. The TypeDescriptors provide additional context about the source and target locations where conversion will occur, often object fields or property locations.
items.translation: 将给定的source转换为指定的targetType。 TypeDescriptors 提供了有关转换发生位置的源和目标位置的额外上下文，通常是对象字段或属性位置。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if targetType is null, or sourceType is null but source is not null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 targetType 为 null，或者 sourceType 为 null 但 source 不为 null。

items.source: sourceType - the source type to convert from (may be null if source is null)
items.translation: sourceType - 要转换的源类型（如果源为 null，则可能为 null）

items.source: sourceType - context about the source type to convert from (may be null if source is null)
items.translation: sourceType - 转换来源的类型上下文（如果来源为 null，则可能为 null）

items.source: true if a conversion can be performed, false if not
items.translation: true 如果可以执行转换，否则为 false

items.source: true if a conversion can be performed between the source and target types, false if not
items.translation: true 如果可以在源类型和目标类型之间执行转换，否则为 false

items.source: source - the source object to convert (may be null)
items.translation: source - 要转换的源对象（可为 null）

items.source: the converted object, an instance of targetType
items.translation: 转换后的对象，即 `targetType` 的一个实例。

items.source: targetType - context about the target type to convert to (required)
items.translation: targetType - 要转换的目标类型的上下文（必需）

items.source: Keith Donald, Phillip Webb
items.translation: Keith Donald，Phillip Webb

items.source: the converted object, an instance of targetType
items.translation: 转换后的对象，即 targetType 的实例

items.source: source - the source object
items.translation: source - 源对象

items.source: targetType - the target type
items.translation: targetType - 目标类型

items.source: the converted value
items.translation: 转换后的值
